description: Question 1 of 3 for 2026-08-21: is the desk entering at the end of the move? On 2026-08-20, 29 of 59 entries were taken with entry_exhaustion_state=overbought, and desk_report's forward-return-by-exhaustion table falls off a cliff there: 0-25% +0.315%, 25-50% +0.364%, 50-75% -0.248%, 75-90% +0.462%, 90-100% -0.797%. ai_watch_exhaustion_heat_max_pct is the ceiling that would refuse a hot entry and ships disabled at 0. ob_allow_hot is already False live, so it is swept only to confirm it is not the thing doing the work. Exit knobs are pinned at live values throughout: this grid must not be able to win by retuning the trail. RUN THIS FIRST — it is the largest lever the 2026-08-20 reports exposed.
